decisions.ruling: Drop the bun tool. User, 2026-11-27: "none of my projects are using bun as of now, we can drop support for bun".
decisions.rejected: Keep bun, with a common _js tool for the skills of node and bun

decisions.decision: Which tool does android depend on?
decisions.ruling: android depends on java and kotlin: depends = [ "java", "kotlin" ]. Android is Kotlin-first; java stays a direct dependency, because the mise depends of a tool come from its direct depends only (cli/internal/misegen/extend.go:115-160), and android-sdk needs the JDK of java. flutter gets kotlin through android: the ktlint and detekt gates, the seeds .config/detekt.yml and .config/ktlint.editorconfig, setup:deps:30-kotlin and the Kotlin LSP. User, 2026-11-27: "Yes, flutter gets kotlin through android".
decisions.rejected: android depends on java only; or split android into an SDK tool and an app tool

decisions.decision: What happens to bunfig.toml in a consumer?
decisions.ruling: bunfig.toml is a seed, so the consumer owns it and keeps it. It gets no row in "Files that bootstrap no longer ships", because step 4 deletes each path of that table and the adoption check (docs/sync/index.md:308) fails while one exists. M60 says that bunfig.toml stays, and that the user can delete it by hand.
decisions.rejected: A row in "Files that bootstrap no longer ships", or a migrate item that deletes bunfig.toml

decisions.ruling: Two items. M60 (the bun tool is gone): every engine command reads the clone, so bootstrap remove tool bun fails with code 3 once bun is gone; the steps are: delete the [tools.bun] table (and any [overrides.tools.bun]) from .config/bootstrap/tools.toml by hand, and each override that names bun ([overrides.mise.tools.bun], [overrides.mise_env.<env>.tools.bun]), select node with pnpm or aube when the repository still needs a package manager, then run mise run setup:configs; bunfig.toml stays (D3). M61 (android brings kotlin): the next sync adds the kotlin tool, its gates and seeds to an android or flutter repository; when the new gates fail on existing Kotlin code (for example the MainActivity.kt of Flutter), run mise run code:format --fix for ktlint, then fix each detekt finding in the code; never weaken the seeds. When setup:deps:30-kotlin stops because gradle-wrapper.properties has no distributionSha256Sum, add the checksum as the message of the task says.
No review unit. The one runnable change deletes the bun skip (three lines) of repo/tools/node/tasks/setup-deps-node.py, and the wave review covers it.
decisions.rejected: A review unit for three deleted lines

decisions.ruling: teams: the default; no technical reason forces solo.

decisions.decision: Which lines of toml-yq.golden may change when U3 regenerates it?
decisions.ruling: Only the lines of the TOML files this plan changes or deletes (the bun files and repo/tools/android/tools.toml). Any other changed line is reported as a QUESTION and not kept.
decisions.rejected: Keep whatever the local yq writes

decisions.decision: Do the migrate cases that need CLAUDE_PLUGINS_CLONE run?
decisions.ruling: Yes. U1 Verification and the plan gate set CLAUDE_PLUGINS_CLONE=$HOME/Projects/github.com/virajp/claude-plugins, so the cases that add android run.

decisions.decision: kotlin comes in the environments of android (dev and ci), so the CI of each Android and Flutter repository installs ktlint and detekt and runs the two gates. Intended?
decisions.ruling: Yes. User, 2026-11-27: "Yes, run the Kotlin gates in CI". kotlin keeps default_envs = [ "dev" ] for a repository that selects it alone.
decisions.rejected: Keep kotlin dev-only in an android repository (an engine rule for one tool)

decisions.decision: Do the gate lines pass --all with a -- separator?
decisions.ruling: No. Keep mise x -- mise run code:format --all and mise x -- mise run code:lint --all: mise passes the arguments after the task name to the task, and the repo uses this form (CLAUDE.md: mise run test --all).

decisions.decision: The unit contract says a unit never runs a generator and never edits a doc. Which rule wins for U1, U2 and U3?
decisions.ruling: The two fixed final units are the template exceptions: U2 (docs) edits the docs it owns, and U3 (gates) runs the golden generator. U1 Edit 3 runs bootstrap sync only in a scratch consumer outside the worktree, as a check; it writes nothing in the tree.
decisions.rejected: Move the golden regeneration and the scratch check to the orchestrator

decisions.decision: android-sdk gets the mise tools of every direct depend, so its computed depends becomes java plus the mise tools of kotlin (ktlint, github:detekt/detekt, in dev maybe http:kotlin-lsp). Accepted?
decisions.ruling: Accepted: the extra entries only order the installs. The Computed depends cell of the android row of docs/design/mise.md:524 gets the value that the generator writes, read from a generated conf.d/android/mise.<env>.toml of U1 Edit 3.
decisions.rejected: Change extend.go to take only the JDK

decisions.decision: The migrate case checkGoldenPartsQuiet (android + swift, real mise run test:golden, no auto install) now also gets the kotlin mise tools. What if real mise no longer exits 0 there with no network?
decisions.ruling: Accepted as an open case: U1 runs it; if it fails only because of the kotlin tools, U1 reports a QUESTION with the output and the options (change the values of the case, or accept), and changes nothing else.
decisions.rejected: Change the case before the run without evidence

decisions.decision: Q1: D2 says Write this wording in every doc. Must every doc that states the new android closure carry the full D2 wording, or only the part that fits each doc?
decisions.ruling: Keep the per-doc wording as written. No more edits; each doc keeps the part that fits its subject.
decisions.rejected: Full wording in every doc that states the closure — U2 adds the missing parts to kotlin.md, java.md, migrate.md M61 and docs/design/mise.md:805
